title: backlog MCP — Persistent Cross-Session Task Management
description: Persistent, cross-session task management MCP server for Claude Code. 24 MCP tools covering tasks, projects, tags, dependencies, and docs. 7 skills for planning, standups, and handoffs. Event-sourced storage (pure TypeScript, zero external dependencies) so tasks survive session close and can be picked up by another agent. Key distinction from TodoWrite: TodoWrite is in-session only and lost on /clear or session end; backlog persists across sessions and enables agent-to-agent task handoffs. Could replace the manual BACKLOG.md convention for projects needing multi-agent coordination. Listed in ComposioHQ/awesome-claude-plugins (April 2026).
